### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A21, A22 and A23 were mandatory and always ran together: each appeared exactly once in every one of the 200 cases, with no fixed order among the three (for example, A21 preceded A22 in about 52 in 100 cases and followed it in about 48). In the later window, all three have nearly vanished, each appearing in about 1 in 200 cases. [OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, REL025, REL026, REL031]
- Earlier, this block sat between A39 and A24: A39 preceded each of the three in every case, each of the three led to A24 in roughly 28–37 in 100 of its outgoing transitions (otherwise to one of the other two block activities), and A24 was present in every case. [REL027, REL028, REL032, REL033, REL036, REL037, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, POS007]
- In the later window, three previously unobserved activities appear: A14 in about 30 in 100 cases, A15 in about 33 and A16 in about 37 (each at most once per case). They never occur together — pairwise co-occurrence is zero — and exactly one of them runs in about 199 of 200 later cases. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, REL001, REL002, REL010]
- A39 now routes into these alternatives: its outgoing transitions, previously spread roughly equally over A21, A22 and A23 (about 35/30/35 in 100), now go to A16, A15 and A14 (about 37/33/30 in 100). Every observed outgoing transition of A14, A15 and A16 leads to A24, with A39 before and A24 after each of them. [DIR007, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, REL006, REL007, REL014, REL015, REL021, REL022]
- The new activities occupy roughly the same relative event position (mean about 0.35 of the trace) that A21–A23 held before (about 0.37); A24, present throughout in both windows, now sits slightly earlier (mean about 0.43 to 0.39), A39 slightly later (about 0.31 to 0.33), and A40 is present throughout with a nearly unchanged position (about 0.85 to 0.84). [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, POS007, POS008, POS009]
- A41 accompanied the old block in about 59 in 100 earlier cases; in the later window it runs in about 69 in 100 cases and co-occurs with A14, A15 or A16 in about 21–26 in 100 cases, usually after them. [REL030, REL009, REL017, REL024]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that the segment between A39 and A24 was restructured: the always-executed block A21–A23, which every earlier case ran in full (each activity once, in varying order), was replaced by exactly one of three alternative activities, A14, A15 or A16, so a later case runs A39 → one of A14/A15/A16 → A24 where it previously ran A39 → A21, A22 and A23 together → A24. The support is direct and consistent: participation flipped from 200 of 200 cases to about 1 in 200 for the old block and from 0 to 60–74 cases for the new activities; A39's outgoing transitions moved from the old block to the new alternatives with full 200-case coverage in both windows; the surrounding order (A39 before, A24 after) is preserved; and the screening context makes chance an unlikely explanation, with 61 qualifying items against roughly 0.57 expected if nothing had changed, each difference exceeding about 199 of 200 random re-splits. Limitations: the later-window routing out of A21, A22 and A23 rests on a single trace each and was not relied on, and one window cannot confirm whether the choice among A14, A15 and A16 (about 30/33/37 in 100) is meant to be uniform. An important competing explanation the evidence cannot rule out is a shift in the mix of cases entering the process — a different variant population — rather than a modification of one and the same process. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, DIR007, REL001, REL002, REL010, REL027, REL028, REL032, REL033, REL036, REL037]

Other differences: A41's participation rose from about 59 to about 69 in 100 cases, and it now co-occurs with A14, A15 or A16 (about 21–26 in 100 cases, usually after them) where it previously always accompanied the A21–A23 block; A24 now sits slightly earlier and A39 slightly later in relative event position, while A40 is essentially unchanged. [REL030, REL009, REL017, REL024, POS007, POS008, POS009]
